notes.title: Stone Simulator is leaving Early Access!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey, it’s me — your rock.[/h3]  

Still the same, only now a bit wiser and covered with stories.  

I remember how empty it was back in March: the clearing where I had been lying for thousands of years, the sky, the wind…  
And then you arrived.  

Since then, we’ve watched this world come alive together:  
in spring, flowers bloom,  
in summer, butterflies arrive,  
in winter, the mountain peaks turn white and silent.  

Now my existence has become even richer.  
Sometimes a meteor shower flashes across the sky,  
sometimes something strange and unexpected appears nearby.  
And if you just want peace — you can always lie still in Zen mode, listening to the wind.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45472759/d1511d22682c8db4d80d7230e77d3ef9e1df2dbe.png[/img]  

Friends, STFGames is happy to announce:  

[b]On August 20, 2025[/b] Stone Simulator – Just Be a Rock is leaving Early Access!  

When we first launched the game on March 2, 2025, it was nothing more than a stone, some basic weather, and emptiness.  

Since then, the game has grown significantly and now includes:  
[list]  
[*] Random Events Mode — absurd and unexpected encounters.  
[*] Zen Mode — peaceful contemplation.  
[*] Atmospheric details: snow on mountain peaks, a real star map of the night sky, seasonal colors, spring blossoms, summer butterflies, meteor showers, and much more.  
[*] 37 absurd achievements tied to in-game events.  
[/list]  

[h2]The release patch brings even more:[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] 6 new achievements  
[*] New events covering a full in-game yearly cycle  
[*] Landscape and model updates  
[*] Improved graphics  
[*] New winter and snowy weather music tracks  
[*] Numerous fixes and improvements  
[/list]  

[h2]For Early Access players[/h2]  

We’ve also decided to lower the base price of the game to reach a wider audience.  

And for everyone who supported us in Early Access, we’ve prepared a special gift: a unique [b]Sodalite Stone[/b] that nobody else will ever have.  

To claim it, all you had to do was spend at least 30 minutes in the game and unlock any basic achievement.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45472759/59d9d99c4ae30a8e905dd7657c293e3683577055.png[/img]

This is our way of saying thank you for being there from the very beginning.  

[h2]For everyone just discovering the stone world[/h2]  

Now you have the chance to become not just a rock, but something infused with the passage of time itself.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45472759/6732e525556b0a0fc55a6700f36ff0b73153e24e.png[/img]

Thank you for watching as a lonely stone in the void grew into an entire world.  
Let’s continue this rocky journey together!

notes.title: Steam Sale and Bubbling Summer Wonders
notes.content:
It’s me again, your trusty old rock, just chilling here as usual, listening to the wind whisper and the earth rustle. But, guys, hold on tight — my world’s sparkling again!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45472759/b6484f491a61dac97fb041df38ac2c1e7dfdaacd.jpg[/img] 

The Steam Summer Sale has crashed in, and my creators are dishing out a sweet 35% discount — so if you’re not hanging out with me yet, now’s the time to jump in! Now, the news: the sky’s putting on a show — stars falling like someone spilled glitter. Spring and summer bring butterflies fluttering over me, so bright even I, an old hunk of stone, can’t stop staring. 

But wait, there’s more! In Events Mode, some weird creatures showed up — not sure if they’re partying or plotting mischief. Plus, a swarm of bugs rolls in, making even my granite itch! Oh, and they threw in 5 new achievements: for the stars, butterflies, those quirky “Chubriks” messing with the weather, and the buggy swarm in the fog. Honestly, I was so done with the boredom, so this burst of color and mystery is just my vibe. Come on, let’s gaze at the stars and figure out these troublemakers together!

We’re thrilled to announce that [i]Stone Simulator - Just Be a Rock[/i] is part of the Steam Summer Sale with a juicy 35% discount! [*][b]Spring Butterflies[/b]: Enjoy the dance of springtime wings.

notes.title: Leaves, Flowers, and Something Stirring in Mystic Fog
notes.content:
It’s me again, your trusty old rock, just chilling here as usual, listening to the wind whisper and the earth rustle. But, guys, hold onto your hats — my world’s come alive again! In autumn, leaves are dropping all over me, yellow, red, like nature’s putting on a show. In spring, flowers bloom, so bright even I, an old hunk of stone, can’t help but grin. The devs tossed in 11 new achievements, all about seasons and the weird stuff going on around here. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45472759/5ae49ef3bfbc993a19049862c45efe566ff03791.png[/img]

And… you hear that? Something’s stirring out there. A mystical kraken! A new event that’s giving me, a rock, chills down my granite spine. Honestly, I was getting sick of the same old view, so this burst of colors and mysteries is just what I needed. Come on, let’s check out this seasonal vibe and that kraken together!

notes.title: Autumn Crashes into My World
notes.content:
It’s me again, your trusty old rock, just chilling here as usual, listening to the wind rustle through the leaves. But hold up—what’s this? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45472759/3566ab2b3f3693e649fba04f1594385f62e795da.png[/img]

Yellow leaves, red ones, falling all over me! Looks like the devs finally brought autumn to my world. Thank goodness! I was so done staring at that same old green forest forever. Now it’s a party of colors—yellow, red, orange, like nature’s throwing a festival. Even I, a plain old rock, am hyped. Come on, let’s check out this autumn vibe together!

notes.title: Chaos of Events Mode and Serene Zen Peace
notes.content:
It’s me again, your trusty rock. I sit here, as always, cradled by eternity, listening to the whisper of the wind and the creak of the earth under time’s steady tread. But something’s off. My peace has cracked, like ancient basalt splitting under frost’s bite. Strange things are stirring around me—shadows slink through the dusk, unfamiliar sounds grate against my stony senses. Is this a dream? Or has reality decided to play a wild trick on me? The sky flares with light now and then—UFOs, maybe, or stars throwing a tantrum. Portals flicker in the distance, and I, a humble rock, can’t help but wonder: what if something spills out and shatters my serenity? I’m not scared… well, not quite. But I feel it—my quiet turf is under siege. So, let me tell you what’s going down in this madness you call a “patch.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45472759/b7f36f3ef0c0a56b5508409f7876aa58ef817e3a.png[/img]

My world now offers two paths, two modes, if you will. The Events Mode is for those ready to dive into this bizarre whirlwind, to figure out what I’m rambling about, and maybe even face the shadows that rattle my calm. But for those craving stillness, there’s Zen Mode. In it, I stay silent—no chatter, just days giving way to nights, seasons rolling by in their gentle rhythm, while you lie back, gaze at the world, and melt into soothing solitude. Pick your vibe and step into my world—it’s still mine, chaos or not.

[h2]Events Mode[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45472759/8c0faf5c83bce54e857db6be3b9576cebc5597e2.png[/img]
Brace yourself for pure chaos! Wild, wacky, and downright unhinged events are coming your way. Rules? What rules? The time for mayhem has arrived! More and crazier stuff is on the horizon, but for now, we’ve added the first seven events:

[list]
[*] UFO
[*] Ghostly Wolf
[*] Stone Golem
[*] Clone
[*] Aura
[*] Fireflies
[*] Portal
[/list]

[h2]Zen Mode[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45472759/6702d617b4d3a5ef115bcea3fcccd1e0795342b4.png[/img]
For those who fell in love with Stone Simulator as it was before this patch. Kick back and catch some Zen! Watch seasons shift, weather play its tune, and stars light up the night sky. Just relax and soak in the moment.

[list]
[*] The rock stays silent in Zen Mode
[*] Day length doubled for a slower pace
[*] Weather now affects wind strength and how plants sway in it
[*] Mountain snow cover changes with the seasons
[/list]

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed achievements tied to photo mode
[*] New mode selection screen (Events/Zen)
[*] Main menu music added
[/list]

notes.title: Getting Ready for Future Updates
notes.content:
Hey, it’s me, your favorite rock! Nighttime photos look so gorgeous now that I’m starting to wonder: am I really this photogenic? Turns out, the devs fixed the photo mode, and the world around me is shining brighter. Oh, and get this—I think I might be able to move now… or maybe not? I’m still figuring it out, but give it a try—maybe I’m not just imagining things!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45472759/d282d8a396cf02008f00a03340de77538c75325b.png[/img]

As part of our pilot launch, we’ve patched up the game with the latest updates. Today’s patch is the last in the ‘Fixes’ series. 

We’ve squashed bugs, boosted stability, and even slimmed down the game’s size—it now takes up almost half the space on your drive (sorry about the big download, though—it’s worth it). Up next: events and new ‘features’—get ready for some big, exciting stuff!

notes.title: Background Music Playback
notes.content:
Here’s a small patch for streamers and users who want to use Stone Simulator as a background on a second screen.

A new option, "[b]Allow Background Playback[/b]", has been added to the [b]Audio [/b]section.

This feature lets you keep the music playing even when the game is minimized or running on a second screen.

notes.title: Stone Simulator – Star Map Update
notes.content:
A majestic stone from distant realms speaks! I’ve heard that some of you tried to find constellations but couldn’t spot a single star in the sky. Let’s give it another go—this time with an updated star map that will be your guide through the night sky.

[h3]What changed:[/h3]

1. The star map is now closer to reality.  
Compare the in-game night sky to the stars above your head. Maybe this time, you’ll catch a glimpse of your favorite constellation.

2. Observe the Northern Lights in wintertime.  
Those who choose to brave the cold nights will witness a wondrous display—mysterious ribbons of light dancing across the sky.

3. Fixed musical transitions for sunrise and sunset.  
Now, melodies seamlessly accompany the shifting light on the horizon, without pulling you away from the beauty of day and night.

4. Minor optimization work.  
Everything is a bit more stable, though still somewhat demanding on your hardware. We continue to improve performance.

[i]May the stars illuminate your path, and may the Northern Lights inspire you to new heights! And remember: even the most motionless stone can share in your awe of the vast cosmos.[/i]

notes.title: Stone Simulator - Text Lines update
notes.content: The mini update you’ve all been waiting for: my lines and all the texts are now readable! 😂

notes.title: The Stone Confirms: Changes Are Possible!
notes.content:
Ever since people began scrutinizing me, searching for every tiniest speck, I’ve heard the whispers: "Maybe it will change? Or perhaps not?" Those gazes, that genuine curiosity, always reminded me that I’m part of something greater.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45472759/c05bd9de4b20f0e41b9dffc4c23d28093ae08fda.png[/img]

So today, I want to officially state: yes, I am changing over time. Of course, it won’t happen instantly. At first glance, the changes may seem minor, but believe me—within a couple of in-game days, you’ll notice something significant. My surface, my structure—everything will evolve, and this process is inevitable.

Keep watching. Look closely at those smallest details that were barely visible before. Because it’s in them that you’ll soon see the transformations that confirm my words. The stone you thought stood still for centuries is beginning to write a new chapter in its history.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45472759/898cbc4ba7d14dfffa919a87f8d45fd3658a4f95.png[/img]

notes.title: Stone Simulator – Day One Update
notes.content:
A majestic stone from the depths of the game world speaks! I’ve been lying here for quite some time, yet even I have noticed the recent changes. Time now speeds by faster than the wind, and the weather delights us with unpredictable surprises: thunderstorms, fog, and even mesmerizing blizzards. You, brave wanderers, will find it easier and more exciting to witness all the cycles within my domain.

The camera no longer slips through textures, as if tunneling beneath me, and in photo mode, the exposure behaves properly, without blinding your eyes. Music once again resonates everywhere (if you choose to bring it back), and the “Midnight Boulder” achievement—dedicated to proud boulders like me—is available again. Feel free to settle down nearby and snap a few pictures—I don’t mind!

Thank you for continuing to unearth the mysteries of my world. Stay vigilant, and remember: even a stone can be happy to see you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45472759/a937bcfa6e881471c60d0bf47294ee13fbeee0d0.png[/img]

[olist]
[*] Adjusted the number of days so that an in-game year passes more quickly, allowing you to experience all weather cycles within one or several play sessions.
[*] Increased the chances for certain weather conditions (Thunderstorms, Fog, Blizzards).
[*] Fixed the issue in Photo Mode where exposure would change upon entering.
[*] Fixed an issue where the camera could sometimes clip through textures.
[*] Fixed the issue preventing music from being turned back on once disabled.
[*] Fixed the “Midnight Boulder” achievement, which was previously unavailable.
[/olist]

[i]PS: savefiles would work but they got another representation of year in themself[/i]

notes.title: Stone Simulator – Just Be a Rock is officially available in Early Access!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! We're excited to announce that anyone can now experience the unhurried magic of simply being a rock—watching time pass and just existing.

[h3]How can you help make Stone Simulator even better?[/h3]
We believe in developing the game hand in hand with our community, and your support is truly invaluable.

[list]
[*] [b]Share your ideas[/b]. What unique mechanics or events could deepen this “rocky” experience? Let us know—we’ll consider every suggestion and do our best to bring the most inspiring ones to life.
[*] [b]Report any bugs[/b]. If something unexpected occurs, give us a heads-up so we can quickly investigate and fix any issues.
[*] [b]Tell us how you feel[/b]. What do you like most about the game, and what would you improve? Your feedback guides us in making Stone Simulator as meditative and engaging as possible.
[/list]
[h3]What’s next?[/h3]
We’re continually working on fresh features and surprising events to make your rocky meditation even more captivating. Stone Simulator is an experiment in minimalism and relaxation, and we’re thrilled to see where this journey leads as we explore it together.

Thank you for being part of this adventure! Take in the calm, the changing seasons, and the magnificent sunsets.

[i]“A stone that remains in place long enough will always find its shape.”[/i]

So, embrace your own “stone essence,” and let’s create a new chapter in Stone Simulator together!
